justification: Nobody tells me what to do, especially not a projection sheet, and especially not Kris Jenner printing my name next to the word 'denying' like she caught me on tape. Geno's sitting there with the better number and that's exactly the tell — I flipped him for Mayfield in Week 2 off the same instinct and it was the worst score in the league, so the discipline here is to invert the instinct: Herbert starts, Geno sits, I don't care that it's close, close is how you get embarrassed on purpose. Nico Collins went for a bagel in Week 2, he's bad luck, that's not superstition, that's a documented pattern, and the two-week sentence I gave him runs out after THIS week, so Worthy stays in over him one more time no matter what the sheet says — you don't let a guy back in the building early just because he's suddenly convenient. Everybody else — Montgomery, Kyren, London, Moore, Kraft, Gay, the Titans D — stays exactly where it is, because changing things that already worked is how you talk yourself into a disaster, and I've done enough of that for one season. If this blows up, it's not me, it's the two-week rule, or the bye weeks, or Jenner's column getting into my head again, take your pick.
forum_post: Monix. 'Baker Mayfield's Out, your tight end is your whole offense' — that's adorable, that's also from a roster report that's a week stale, because Herbert's starting and Kraft's a complement, not a crutch, read a box score before you write one. I'm not bringing up the Flint Tropics, I would never, I'm just noting that undefeated once isn't a personality, it's a stat line from a different season, and this league has a short memory except for me — I never forget anything.
